tokens.npc_dota_hero_enigma_bio:
Nothing is known of Enigma's background. There are only stories and legends, most of them apocryphal, passed down through the ages. In truth, Enigma is a mystery for whom the only true biography is description: he is a universal force, a consumer of worlds. He is a being of the void, at times corporeal, other times ethereal. A beast between the planes.

There are stories that say he was once a great alchemist who tried to unlock the secrets of the universe and was cursed for his arrogance. Other legends tell that he is an ancient being of strange gravity, the abyss personified--a twisted voice from out the original darkness, before the first light in the universe. And there are older legends that say he is the first collapsed star, a black hole grown complicated and sentient--his motivations unknowable, his power inexorable, a force of destruction unleashed upon existence itself.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_enigma_hype: Widely feared for his ultimate ability, Enigma can summon a black hole capable of entrapping enemy forces, so that allies can then destroy them. An ever-present contingent of eidolons at his side, he pummels foes with ranged attacks.

fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Aura}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-3-2.png|84px]]
*** Creates a negative [[aura]] at the area-targeted location and deals {{calc|v1*{{#var:Midnight Pulse basic1}}|v1={{#var:Midnight Pulse value2}}}} + {{calc|v1*{{#var:Midnight Pulse basic1}}|v1={{#var:Midnight Pulse value3}}|%}} {{M|current health}} to affected enemy units in {{#var:Midnight Pulse basic1}}-second intervals, over {{calc|v1/{{#var:Midnight Pulse basic}}+1|v1={{#var:Midnight Pulse value4}}}} damage instances with the aura linger duration. 
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Midnight Pulse cast range}}+{{#var:Midnight Pulse value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3r}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Midnight Pulse cast range}}+{{#var:Midnight Pulse value1 tal}}}}|20tal}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|enigma_midnight_pulse_damage}}
***** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration and continues applying the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in the same intervals as the first cast.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Ancient creeps}}.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** [[Trees]] within the effect radius at the area-targeted location are destroyed upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Target|Portrait}}
*** Considers [[portrait-casting]] as a {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} ground-targeted cast, and centers the radius around Enigma.

* {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
** Multiple overlapping Midnight Pulse radius do not stack.

{{Gamedesc
| image = {{#var:Black Hole icon0}}
| desc = CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
}}
* {{Symbol|Channeling|t}} {{to}} {{Symbol|fx|v}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} [[File:Dota2 Anticlockwise.png|31px|Anticlockwise]]
** [[File:Dota2 Enigma Black Hole Visualized (Inner) icon.png|84px|Inner Radius]]
*** [[wikipedia:Logarithmic spiral|Spirals]] affected enemy units anticlockwise while [[channeling]] at {{#expr:0.25*180/pi round2}}° per second.
*** Can be pulled up to {{#expr:{{#var:Black Hole value1}}*{{#var:Black Hole value3}}}}-distance within the inner radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-r.png|21px|R]] . 
*** The closer the units are to the center, the stronger the inner pull.
*** The model of affected units near the center only rotates.
** [[File:Dota2 Enigma Black Hole Visualized (Outer) icon.png|84px|Outer Radius]]
*** Spirals affected enemy units anticlockwise while channeling at {{ValueColor||{{#expr:0.1*180/pi round2}}°|agh}} per second.
*** Can be pulled up to {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Black Hole value1}}*{{#var:Black Hole type1 value2 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance within the outer radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-r.png|21px|R]] .

** Unlike the inner radius, the spiral pull is stronger outward.
** The closer the units are are to the center, the weaker the outer pull.

abilities: Black Hole channels a massive AoE disable that wins fights outright.

items: Linken's Sphere blocks Enigma's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Enigma's magic damage and disables.
Mjollnir / Maelstrom's chain lightning clears Enigma's summons.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Enigma's targeted disable.
Pipe of Insight shields your team from Enigma's AoE magic damage.
Eul's Scepter (or any stun) interrupts Enigma's channelled spell.
